newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Elec to sell DVD-RAM discs by December.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Elec to sell DVD-RAM discs by December.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Friday it plans to start selling DVD-RAM discs by the end of December at prices similar to its PD optical discs, which currently sell for less than 3,000 yen.
It added, however, that no final decision on prices has yet been made.
"We are planning to sell the discs at prices not much different from PDs, at above 3,000 yen but definitely below 5,000 yen," said Matsushita's executive engineer Mutsuo Takenaga.
He added that prices of DVD-RAM discs and drives are expected to decline sharply over time as production rises and the cost benefits of mass production emerge.
Matsushita developed PDs, which are rewritable optical memory discs, in September 1995.
